content: CI norms for research Python repos (model knowledge, corroborated by live listings of what benchmark repos actually run): lint+format via ruff, pytest unit tests, pre-commit hooks, actions pinned to major tags, pip caching, optional version matrix, timeout-minutes, concurrency cancel, README badge from GitHub auto-generated SVG. Real workflows in flagship repos are modest: lm-eval-harness runs unit_tests.yml + publish.yml; HELM runs test-python/test-frontend/test-scenarios/build-frontend/deploy-frontend/publish-pypi/update-deps; DNABERT-2 just check_build.yml. Research-repo guidance: don't commit large datasets, use small synthetic fixtures in CI, tests should cover data processing not GPU training.
